stemMd: Which equation describes the line parallel to y = 4x − 7 through the origin?
explanationMd: Parallel lines have the same slope, so the coefficient of x remains four. Passing through the origin requires zero vertical intercept. Therefore the equation is y = 4x.

distractorRationale.a: This is parallel but does not pass through the origin.
